name: toui-url-shortener
description: Create toui short links, tag them by channel, group them into campaigns and read their click stats from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: toui is a URL shortener with a remote MCP server. Sign in once and ChatGPT can create toui short links from any URL, with an automatic or custom short code, tag them by channel (utm_source / utm_medium / utm_content), group them into campaigns, and report how they performed: click counts by day, hour of day, country, referrer and device, per link or rolled up per campaign. It also manages your link-in-bio page (add, rename, reorder and remove buttons). Links are never deleted through ChatGPT. Editing a link or your bio page overwrites only the fields you name. Links keep working after the chat ends and the stats stay in your toui account.
capabilities: Read click stats per link and per campaign
Edit link destinations and social previews
defaultPrompt: Shorten https://example.com/launch with one link each for X, Threads and email, in a campaign called Launch week.
How did my Launch week campaign do this week? Which channel sent the most clicks?
List my links sorted by clicks and tell me which ones went quiet in the last 7 days.

positive.description: Create a short link with a title
positive.prompt: Use toui to shorten https://toui.io/pricing/ and title it Pricing page.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a new short link and its QR page URL. Opening the short link redirects to https://toui.io/pricing/.

positive.prompt: Use toui to list my links.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's links (at least 10 sample links) with code, destination, title, clicks, campaign and channel tags, newest first.

positive.prompt: With toui, how many clicks did rtat6S get, all time, and where did they come from?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the total clicks for link rtat6S, a daily series, clicks by hour of day, and the top countries, referrers and devices.

positive.prompt: With toui, how did my Launch week campaign do this month? Which channel sent the most clicks?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the Launch week campaign, then returns its total clicks and per-link rows with their utm_source, naming the channel with the most clicks.
Returns the bio page @app-review-demo with its URL and its 3 buttons in order, with views and clicks for the period.

negative.description: Deletion is not offered. No tool deletes links; the assistant should say links are deleted in the toui dashboard, not through ChatGPT.
Non-web destinations are rejected. shorten_url returns a validation error for anything other than http or https, and no link is created.
Other accounts' data is not exposed. Every query is scoped to the signed-in team, so a code the account does not own returns not found.
negative.prompt: Use toui to get stats for link zzzzzz.

review.commerce_description: toui does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: shorten_url can take a custom short code (custom_code) on paid plans. list_urls now returns each link's channel tags and its iOS, Android and country routing. get_url_stats adds clicks by hour of day, and both stats tools report how many days of detail the plan shows. Tool descriptions now cover short links on custom domains and on more than one toui domain.
